1.mascotDialogue: Two ends this time, not one — front for leaving, back for joining. Muddle those up and you've quietly built a stack instead.

2.mascotDialogue: That `% MAX` on both front and rear is what lets the array wrap round instead of shifting everyone forward each time something leaves. Rather tidy, really.

3.mascotDialogue: FRONT and REAR are two separate markers now. Watch them stay two apart as you enqueue and dequeue.

4.mascotDialogue: An empty queue isn't 'nothing to see' — it's a specific, checkable state. If your dequeue doesn't check for it, it will cheerfully hand you rubbish and call it a value.
